key_numbers_transcribed_verbatim.header: The NSL-37V5C4 is an optocoupler that has an OFF-resistance of 400kOhm.
key_numbers_transcribed_verbatim.Ron: 80 Ohm typ @ If=40mA; 150 Ohm typ @ If=10mA; 1.5 KOhm typ @ If=1mA
key_numbers_transcribed_verbatim.decay_time_max: 1.5 ms, time to reach 100KOhm after removal of If=1mA

what_was_read.note: Il PDF e' coerente con se stesso: 75 dB su ~100 ohm a 20 mA danno ~560 kohm al buio, compatibili con 400 kohm minimi. La tabella web del costruttore (famiglia, 2026-10-02) dice invece 400 Mohm.
